title: JA Boxing slot contract: the decorative vertical grid and the link underline read the border roles under a worn design system
steps: S1: Build the sheet a worn system gets from packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/templates/joomla-ja-boxing-modes.json (as ja-boxing-modes-contract.test.mjs does) and read the blocks of .vertical-lines .container-inner, .vertical-lines .col:not(:first-child) and .link-underline.
expect: S1: both .vertical-lines blocks set border-color to var(--ds-c-border-soft…) and .link-underline sets border-bottom-color to var(--ds-c-border…), so EMPTY-1 and BORDER-1 find no hollow box or hard light line taken from the text colour.
evidence: Before this change the 1.0.5 design-system measurement reported EMPTY-1 and BORDER-1 for JA Boxing; after it the 1.0.5 and 1.0.6 measurements have no EMPTY-1 or BORDER-1 hit
fence: Static read of the generated slot sheet; the design-system measurement on a stand shows the pixels
